contribution_requirements: User mandate: everything real, no simulation/fake deploy, verifiable by students. Keep NO '|| true' gates in buildspec. Do NOT touch app/** (serverless path), especially app/appspec.yaml. Internal resource names stay 'coffee-ship*'; only the user-facing app name becomes 'Coffee Shop' via one APP_NAME constant.
key_patterns: Single CDK stack AppPipelineStack owns ECR+cluster+service+ALB+CloudFront+SNS+alarm+pipeline. ALB SG is locked to CloudFront origin-facing prefix list (CfnParameter CloudFrontPrefixListId default pl-31a34658) via cfnAlbSg.addPropertyOverride('SecurityGroupIngress',[...]). ApplicationListenerProps.open defaults true (injects 0.0.0.0/0) so prod listeners use open:false + listener.connections.allowDefaultPortFrom(Peer.prefixList(...)). ECS container name is 'web'. imagedefinitions.json shape [{name,imageUri}] for rolling EcsDeployAction; imageDetails.json shape {ImageURI} for CodeDeploy containerImageInputs taskDefinitionPlaceholder 'IMAGE1_NAME'. CloudFront distributions use CACHING_DISABLED + ALL_VIEWER + HTTP_ONLY origin. Pipeline: Source(S3 source.zip + enableEventBridgeNotification + S3Trigger.NONE + EventBridge rule) -> Build(CodeBuild privileged) -> Deploy-Test(EcsDeployAction rolling) -> Approval(ManualApproval + SNS coffee-ship-approval) -> Deploy-Prod(CodeDeployEcsDeployAction blue/green). App.jsx already imports useEffect.
